# MyDegreeGuide

> > Comprehensive guide to accredited degree programs, from accelerated bachelor's to doctoral degrees, with career insights backed by Bureau of Labor Statistics data.

MyDegreeGuide helps prospective students navigate higher education options across business administration (MBA, DBA), healthcare (DNP, DVM), technology (IT doctorates), and liberal arts programs. The site covers degree definitions, career prospects, accreditation standards from organizations like the Higher Learning Commission and Southern Association of Colleges and Schools, and program rankings at institutions including Arizona State University and Bellevue University.

## Key Topics

- Higher Learning Commission accreditation
- Bureau of Labor Statistics career data
- Master of Business Administration (MBA)
- Doctor of Philosophy (PhD)
- Doctor of Business Administration (DBA)
- Graduate Record Examination (GRE)
- Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA)
- Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges
- Middle States Commission on Higher Education
- Accelerated degree programs
- Online doctoral programs
- Professional doctorates
- Graduate admissions requirements
- Career return on investment (ROI)
- Accredited universities

- [20 Best Online PhD in Information Technology Programs [2026 IT Doctorate Guide]](https://www.mydegreeguide.com/online-phd-information-technology-programs): Online IT doctorate programs at Capella, Bowling Green State, and top schools
- [15 Best PhD in Accounting Online Programs [2026 Guide]](https://www.mydegreeguide.com/online-phd/online-phd-in-accounting): Online accounting doctorate programs at City University Seattle and Drexel
- [Doctor of Nursing Practice (D.N.P.): Definition, Benefits and Career Prospects](https://www.mydegreeguide.com/degrees/doctoral/nursing): DNP terminal degree guide for nurse practitioners and clinical nursing leaders
- [Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (D.V.M.): Definition, Benefits and Career Prospects](https://www.mydegreeguide.com/degrees/doctoral/medicine/veterinary): DVM degree guide covering definition, career paths, and U Penn's VMD program
